source: Regesten der Pfalzgrafen am Rhein, Band II, Nr. 3877
entries.subheading: Nr. 3877: earlier date and abstract; nr. 4288 corrects the date to 30 December 1405.
entries.german: 1405 mai 4 Heidelberg. Kg. Ruprecht gestattet Cuntze Lantschaden von Steynach seiner tochter Ketterlin, gattin Cuntzen s von Rosenberg d. j., 1000 fl. zugelts auf die zweiteil am grossen und kleinen zehenden zu Meckessen (Meckesheim) und den hof zu Gemunden (Neckargemünd), die er von der Pfalz zu leben trägt, zu beweisen. Vermerk: Non transivit durchstrichen.
entries.english: 1405 May 4, Heidelberg. King Ruprecht permits Cuntz Landschad von Steynach to provide his daughter Ketterlin, wife of Kunz von Rosenberg der Jüngere, with a marriage portion of 1,000 florins, secured on the two parts of the great and small tithes at Meckesheim and the farm at Neckargemünd, which he holds as a fief from the Palatinate. Note: “Non transivit” is crossed out.

facts.content: was permitted by King Ruprecht to secure a dowry of 1,000 florins on two thirds of the great and small tithes at Meckesheim and the farm at Neckargemünd.
